extracted.name: Slow Cooker New England Boiled Dinner
extracted.description: This boiled dinner with turkey ham and cabbage is simmered in the slow cooker with potatoes, carrots, and pearl onions for a comforting, one-pot meal.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth, as needed
instruction_lines: Arrange a bed of baby carrots and red potatoes in a slow cooker; place turkey ham flat-side down on top. Add garlic cloves and place cabbage wedges over turkey ham. Pour in enough chicken broth to cover.
Cook on Low for 8 hours; stir in pearl onions and continue to cook until onions are tender, about 30 more minutes.
